items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: Albert King. I just heard a record the other day by Freddie King

ctx.x: B.B. King, Bobby Blue Bland, Albert King. I just heard a record the other day by Freddie King, the late Freddie King. I didn’t even know he cut “Ain’t Nobody’s Business.”
